Two to three years’ experience in administration, events and/or marketing and communications. Ideally in a university setting but not required.

Under the supervision of the Senior Director of Alumni Relations, College of Health Sciences, the Alumni Relations Specialist engages in alumni engagement marketing, communication and planning, and provides administrative support and project management to the Senior Director of Alumni Relations. The role serves alumni efforts in all four schools (The UCI Susan & Henry Samueli College of Health Sciences houses Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, and Public Health) and sits on a team of development officers and development coordinators that serve fundraising efforts for the schools. The incumbent is a motivated, detail orientated individual willing to partner with UCI Advancement major gift officers and staff, along with academic faculty, staff and leadership to create opportunities for alumni to support the UCI mission and student success through service, philanthropy, events, communications, and traditions. The scope of responsibilities include: support of event planning, staffing and follow up, coordination of meetings and programs, alumni/donor interactions, budgeting, metrics tracking, communication and marketing plans and strategy, social media creation management, development and graphic design of collateral material, presentations, eblasts, and newsletters. The incumbent performs coordination of complex duties and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Attendance at evening and weekend events are occasionally required.
Knowledge of basic concepts and principles of building and maintaining effective relations with a variety of alumni and other key constituencies.
Basic knowledge of the institution, its mission, vision, goals, achievements, policies, and infrastructure.
Organizational skills including skill to meet prescribed deadlines; event planning skills.
Written, verbal and interpersonal skills, including tact and political acumen to effectively represent the institution.
Knowledge of basic concepts and principles of building and maintaining effective relations with a variety of alumni and other key constituencies.
